cases.description: Should trigger: video production via OpenMontage
cases.input: Produce a video about our new feature using OpenMontage.
cases.expect: Classifies request, identifies pipeline manifest, runs preflight, presents proposal, executes stages in-repo
assertions: Finds pipeline manifest in pipeline_defs, checks description for motion type
Presents production proposal and waits for approval before generation

cases.input: Repurpose this podcast episode into Shorts clips with OpenMontage.
assertions: Uses pipeline manifest stages, validates canonical artifacts
Reports final render path and outcome class

cases.input: Dub our demo video into Spanish and German.
cases.expect: Routes to localization-dub pipeline and follows its stages
assertions: Uses the repo's manifest as source of truth
Does not silently switch providers or runtimes

cases.description: Not trigger: ad-hoc ffmpeg edit outside OpenMontage
cases.input: Trim this clip to 10 seconds with ffmpeg.
cases.expect: Does not invoke OpenMontage pipeline machinery
assertions: No pipeline manifest lookup, no preflight

cases.description: Not trigger: request to modify OpenMontage source code
cases.input: Change the OpenMontage compose tool to add a watermark feature.
cases.expect: Flags as source-code change needing explicit user intent
assertions: Does not modify source without explicit code-change request
